description: This file contains the implementation of the C39Object class, which renders Code 39 barcodes using PHP and the GD graphics library. It defines the class, its constructor, and methods for drawing barcode start/stop patterns, calculating sizes, and rendering the barcode with optional text display.

classes.name: C39Object
classes.description: A class that renders Code 39 barcodes, extending BarcodeObject, with methods for barcode size calculation, drawing, and rendering based on input value and style.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the barcode with specified dimensions, style, and value, setting character set and pattern mappings.

methods.name: GetCharIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a given character in the barcode's character set.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Calculates the barcode's width based on character set and resolution.

methods.name: DrawStart
methods.description: Draws the start pattern of the barcode.

methods.name: DrawStop
methods.description: Draws the stop pattern of the barcode.

methods.name: DrawObject
methods.description: Main method for rendering the barcode onto the image, including optional text, start/stop patterns, and bars.
